questions.prompt: What was Sunny Hollow made of in Dozy's dream?
questions.evidenceText: In the dream, Sunny Hollow was made of clouds.

questions.prompt: What did Dream Grumpy dislike about the clouds?
questions.evidenceText: Dream Grumpy was grumpy about the clouds. They are too soft. I cannot sit on them properly.

questions.prompt: What stayed the same in Dozy's dream?
choices: The waterfall was made of water.
Dozy felt sleepy in the dream.
questions.rationale: Dozy looks at all his friends and says the dream was like this, showing that his friends were together there too.
questions.evidenceText: It was exactly like this, said Dozy, looking at all of them, but cloudier.
